scope: The 29 production reference requests (the application's ReferenceBuildBySlug at revision 18bbcd47), each rebuilt by the application's BuildRequest under every value of every choice the application offers, one at a time: potion, warlock demon and Demonic Pact sacrifice, Enhancement imbue, fire and air totems, preset rotation, starting distance 0 to 40 yards, fight length 30 to 600 seconds and its variation, the Protection Paladin seal, the builder's simulation spec, Feral form and Hunter style; and on each base request, target level 60 to 62, each execute proportion at 0 and 0.5, and inFrontOfTarget toggled. 1097 distinct requests at 500 iterations, exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.
generator: go run ./tools/reference-capture/options <scratch> SLUG... (from a scratch module whose go.mod replaces github.com/mythicsim/mythicsim/worker with <application>/worker), then the encounter settings set on each base request, iterations set to 500 and identical requests dropped

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: BuildRequest refused 659 choices a spec does not take (imbues outside Enhancement, demons outside Warlock, and so on); they are not variants.

The 6 mismatches share one cause, routed to the target swing owner: a melee attack from in front of a target no one tanks can be parried, and Go logs the parry haste that moves the swing the target never takes. Rust does not track that swing, so only the first-fight log differs; every result matches.
Fixed here: a Feral cat's rage bar, which a Mighty Rage Potion fills and whose Rage makes threat at each fight's end, and a mana potion on a unit without a mana bar, which rolls but gives nothing.
